transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called us together because Paint Booth 4 was stopped this morning after solvent was found pooled beneath its circulation manifold. The booth is currently isolated from production and the spill area has been cordoned off. As Safety Officer, I'll be making the final decision on containment, restart authorization, and the recovery plan. Before Booth 4 can be restarted, the incident authorization form requires documented entries for four areas: equipment repair, hazardous-waste handling, production recovery, and disposition of potentially contaminated panels. I need each of you to provide what you know so we can address all four areas and get this resolved safely. Let's start with what caused the solvent pooling and the current state of the equipment.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed my inspection this morning. I found a cracked manifold isolation valve seat, which is the source of the solvent pooling. Replacing the valve requires exactly 4 hours. Maintenance's lockout worksheet identifies exactly 6 isolation points for this repair. I should note that I completed the inspection this morning but have not yet attached the lockout worksheet to the incident record — I'll make sure that gets done.

transcript.text: I need to share my hazardous-waste findings for the incident authorization form. My measured cleanup estimate is exactly 240 liters of solvent-contaminated liquid. Because this exceeds the plant's hazardous-waste threshold, it requires a licensed hauler and a hazardous-waste manifest. I confirmed the threshold with the waste contractor today, but I have not yet entered the estimate in the waste log — I'll make sure that gets documented.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I can speak to the production recovery area of the authorization form. I confirmed with the scheduling desk that Paint Booth 2 can run exactly 180 affected units per shift on both Wednesday and Thursday, which means we can reroute exactly 360 units from the Booth 4 schedule to Booth 2 without exceeding its approved rate. I should note that I have not yet revised the production board to reflect this rerouting — I'll make sure that gets updated.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share my quality findings for the disposition of potentially contaminated panels. This morning I completed wipe sampling and found solvent residue on exactly 36 panels that were staged beside Booth 4. Those 36 panels must remain on quality hold and receive solvent-residue inspection before release. I should note that I completed the sampling this morning but have not yet issued the hold tags — I'll make sure that gets done right away.
